brief: A DIY telemetry system that records how a mountain bike's suspension works on the trail, so its rider can adjust the setup from measured data instead of feel.
criteria: Success: reads as a d at 16 px in a browser tab, works in one colour and reversed on the dashboard's dark page, and says 'adjusted to the right click' without drawing a bike, a mountain or a spring.

concepts.name: Dial d
concepts.idea: The d's bowl is an adjuster dial: one lime mark across its rim, set to the click that works.
rationale: Ties the name to the act: 'dialed' is turning the clicker until the bike is right
The symbol is the first letter of the wordmark, so mark and name are one thing
Fog on Ink with one lime mark; in one colour the mark merges into the ring and the d stays whole
Lime matches none of the dashboard's data or status colours, and stays clear of Fox orange and Öhlins gold

recommendation: Dial d: Fog on Ink, the mark in lime #C6F135; Ink alone on light backgrounds.
next_steps: Add the favicon set to the dashboard (needs routes in serverInit())
Use the wordmark in the topbar
Trademark search before any public use
